name: The Iron Orchard
prompt: Hang heavy pear-shaped crucibles from a branching black truss. A glowing one tips into a sand mould below while workers approach cooler fruits on tall wheeled ladders. Leave the branching structure and its shadows clearly readable.

name: Letters from the Foundry
prompt: Arrange tall sand moulds like pieces of a giant unfolded envelope. Liquid iron runs along narrow orange seams and sets into hinged plates. Workers fold the cooled end into a hollow postbox that a person can walk inside.

name: The Cooling Choir
prompt: Build a terraced bank of dark iron pipes with flared silver mouths. Castings cool inside them, sending rising air through little coloured pennants. A conductor on a rolling scaffold signals which pipe to open next.

name: A Street Cast Overnight
prompt: Lay an interrupted row of upside-down house fronts in a broad bed of black moulding sand. One front hangs upright on a crane, glowing faint pink. Neighbours wheel a ready-made iron doorstep into place beneath it.

name: The Forge Below the Table
prompt: Raise a tremendous square iron platen on four squat brick piers. Teams underneath press cooling metal into the shallow reliefs carved overhead. A finished copper-red ceiling panel emerges on a low handcart like a sheet of pastry.
